prospective_amendment.timing: after sealing the under-covered 570-step Real-1h and Real-3h stop, before any redesigned learner outcome, generator outcome, synthetic corpus, or synthetic learner score
prospective_amendment.authorization_basis: user-approved coverage-based redesign and latest user-directed practical selection of locally governed LTX-2.3
prospective_amendment.scientific_distinction: the prior stop remains valid for its 570-step protocol but is not evidence that one accepted hour is intrinsically insufficient; this separate exploratory protocol tests matched one-hour arms after at least five contrastive-equivalent data passes
prospective_amendment.outcome_independence: the schedule seeds gates and ceilings are frozen without any synthetic learner outcome and without changing the corrected assets or prior sealed result
prospective_amendment.unchanged: exactly one accepted credited hour per arm; pinned learner triple 4:1:1 schedule; shared adapter; corrected assets; modular German TTS; point estimates only; no grammar aggregate equivalence inference or evaluation-driven generator tuning

sealed_prior_570_step_pilot.limitation: 570 scheduler steps contained about 380 contrastive updates at batch size 2, fewer than one contrastive-equivalent pass over 1244 Real-1h learner records; the same step count covered a still smaller share of Real-3h

learner.seed_derivation: first four bytes of SHA-256('synthetic-video-lean-coverage-redesign|2026-08-02|learner-seed|i') modulo 2147483647 for i=0,1,2
learner.objective_step_basis: ceil((5 passes * 622 contrastive batches per pass) / 4 contrastive updates per complete cycle) = 778 complete cycles; 778 * 6 = 4668 scheduler steps
learner.data_contract: each accepted-hour learner manifest contains exactly 1244 records; contrastive and DINO iterators are independent deterministic streams so non-contrastive scheduler steps do not discard contrastive coverage

calibration_C.semantic_boundary: public semantic categories and frequency bands only; never exact C vocabulary transcripts or sealed evaluation concepts
calibration_C.estimation_contract: freeze immutable public model revisions and hashes, fixed bins plus quartiles, explicit missingness and abstention, bootstrap uncertainty with public seed 42, and one governed commitment before generation
calibration_C.limitations: small feature set only; measured and unavailable features reported separately; no full distributional calibration claim
calibration_C.disclosure: Git and external reporting receive only compact non-identifying bins targets uncertainty missingness and a commitment after applicant disclosure review; suppress sparse or reconstructive cells and never export raw media text exact vocabulary embeddings row-level per-child or per-session statistics IDs or reconstructive combinations
calibration_C.episode_plan: freeze a public nonrestricted episode-plan distribution matched axis-by-axis to approved targets using only public lexical resources and no sealed evaluation concepts or outcomes
calibration_C.local_generator_input: inside applicant-governed Juno storage LTX may consume the committed compact C aggregate target table and public self-authored episode-plan distribution; neither the table nor aggregate-conditioned prompts leave the governed boundary
calibration_C.attempt_accounting: measure every generated attempt and the accepted corpus separately
calibration_C.scale_up_evidence: real arm learns; synthetic improves over initialization; synthetic-real realistic macro gap at most 0.05; held-out-real temporal safeguard non-catastrophic; no critical calibration-axis failure; most axes within frozen tolerances; no severe preregistered joint-distribution miss; acceptable unique-hour yield and cost
calibration_C.authorization_interpretation: local applicant-only LTX execution keeps every C aggregate and aggregate-conditioned generator input inside governed UTD storage and grants no third-party access

nested_order: HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-budget') || UTF8(opaque_session_id)); then HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-item') || UTF8(opaque_media_id))
acquisition: reuse the sealed exact Real-1h manifest; no additional real acquisition; synthetic may exceed one raw generated hour only within the frozen production ceilings to yield exactly one accepted credited hour
credited_time: union of unique accepted source-timeline ASR windows with decodable eligible frames; adapter abstentions receive zero
checkpoint_rule: for each matched seed save byte-identical initialized state before optimization; Real-1h and Synthetic-1h use the checkpoint immediately after exactly 4668 scheduler steps; no arm-specific tuning stopping or selection
initialized_baseline: evaluate byte-identical 0h initialization before training without adapting any rule

real_1h_positive_control_gate.temporal_rule: for every seed Recall@1 and MRR must be finite and neither may decline by more than 0.05 absolute from its initialized baseline

generator_gate.selection_basis: latest prospective user-directed practical local-execution choice made before any redesigned learner outcome, new generator outcome, synthetic corpus, or synthetic learner score
generator_gate.bakeoff_interpretation: Gemini led at 27/28 primary checks, MiniMax H3 scored 25/28, Seedance 24/28, and LTX 19/28; LTX is a practical local choice and must never be described as the bakeoff quality winner
generator_gate.execution: applicant-only local execution on governed Juno storage with pinned cached dependencies local-files-only loading disabled telemetry and no hosted API
generator_gate.preflight_gate: only after the Real-1h positive control passes, run bounded public/dummy final-topology sizing and freeze the actual Juno GPU count type wall-time aggregate GPU-hours and storage before generation

production_ceiling_provisional_until_pre.accounting: retain GPU time energy storage failed attempts retries QA labor accepted-hour yield and all attributable costs

generator_gate.privacy: all C aggregates aggregate-conditioned prompts plans attempts outputs logs media QA and artifacts remain in applicant-governed Juno storage; no ChildLens or BabyView material or derivative is sent to a hosted provider
generator_gate.quality_limitation: LTX had the weakest completed-bakeoff primary score and more critical failures; do not tune evaluation assets plans retries or QA thresholds from learner outcomes
generator_gate.audio: discard LTX native audio and retain the frozen modular German TTS path plus repaired common language adapter

synthetic_arm: only after the redesigned multi-pass Real-1h positive control passes and the governed C commitment plus LTX topology/resource preflight pass; produce exactly one accepted credited hour and reuse it for every matched learner seed
positive_learning_signal: per arm the mean seed-matched realistic macro gain is at least 0.02 and at least two of three seed gains are positive; all temporal safeguards satisfy the frozen non-catastrophic rule
directionally_competitive_rule: both arms meet the positive learning signal and the absolute difference between their mean realistic lexical macros is at most 0.05
null_interpretation: a similar null or decline is inconclusive about corpus data quality and cannot be called directional comparability
